deploy-bot: Scheduled migration job '2026_04_add_account_idx' for production during change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Pinned runtime version: r12.3. Canary on 2% of traffic for first 10m, auto-rollback on error threshold >3.
rachael: heads-up: this backfill touches the accounts table (hot). backfill script is `backfill_account_idx --batch-size=500 --sleep-ms=50`. plan to run in rolling batches.
sam: what's the rollback plan if we see >1s p95 read latency?
michael: rollback plan: 1) stop backfill job; 2) flip feature flag `account_idx_enable` -> false; 3) deploy fallback index removal tombstone `deploybot rollback-index 2026_04_add_account_idx --no-drop` (manual confirm). also have read-replica traffic-shift runbook.
danielle: add me as approver for manual abort. I'll be on-call in the window.
rachael: confirm migration steps:
```
-- apply index concurrently
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_accounts_email ON accounts (lower(email));
-- then run backfill tool
backfill_account_idx --dry-run
```
sam: can we set a holdpoint at +30m to verify no p99 spike?
michael: yes, deploybot will post a canary-check event at +10m and +30m. We'll treat +30m as a manual holdpoint: do not proceed to full rollout without :thumbsup: from oncall.
deploy-bot: Canary checks scheduled: 02:10 UTC and 02:30 UTC. Canary will run sample queries and latency probes. Failure -> automatic pause and notify #incidents.
rachael: release notes draft: "Add concurrent index on accounts.email for search performance; rolling back safe via feature flag. Backfill will run in small batches to avoid hotspotting." Link: https://redwood-internal/release-notes/2026-04-account-idx
danielle: add note to ops runbook: if `pg_locks` > 50 for >2m, abort backfill and open pager.
sam: verifying pinned version r12.3 — that prevents the runtime optimizer change that regressed concurrent index builds last month, right?
michael: correct. r12.3 has the stable index-building kernel. We pinned to avoid surprise.
oncall-bot: @danielle scheduled as approver for this window (02:00-03:00 UTC). Pager rotations: primary: danielle, secondary: sam.
rachael: small nit — enable monitoring alert for cross-AZ replica lag > 5s during backfill.
michael: agreed. we'll add a short-lived Datadog monitor and tag `migration:2026_04_add_account_idx`.
deploy-bot: Preflight checks passing: schema lint ✅, canary image build ✅, runtime pin r12.3 locked ✅. Proceed at 02:00 UTC unless a hold requested.
sam: I'll be watching p95/p99 and the replica lag. ping me at 02:08 if canary runs. :eyes:
rachael: thanks everyone. i'll post final confirmation 15m before window.
deploy-bot: Final status update will be posted as thread comment when the job starts and after each canary check. Good luck! :party_parrot:
